class.name: prox_mpc_test_models/NonFiniteTwist
class.description: Fault-injection test model: finite linear dynamics (state [x, y, theta], control [v, omega]) but a deliberately non-finite toTwist(), used to exercise the controller's non-finite-command fail-safe. Test fixture only.

class.name: prox_mpc_test_models/AsymmetricBounds
class.description: Fixture model with an asymmetric range on every declared bound (state [x, y, theta], control [v, omega]): reverse speed capped tighter than forward speed, and a harder braking rate than accelerating rate. Used to test that the controller preserves bound asymmetry instead of assuming symmetry. Test fixture only.

class.name: prox_mpc_test_models/NonFiniteTwistOtherAxes
class.description: Fault-injection test model: finite linear dynamics (state [x, y, theta], control [v, omega]) but a toTwist() that deliberately fills linear.y and angular.x (not linear.x, which NonFiniteTwist already covers) with non-finite values, exercising the controller's command validation on the four Twist components a planar consumer never reads. Test fixture only.

class.name: prox_mpc_test_models/PermutedPlanarMapping
class.description: Fixture model whose state vector is ordered [theta, x, y] instead of [x, y, theta], so its declared planar mapping is idx_yaw = 0, idx_x = 1, idx_y = 2. Obstacle avoidance is on, so it also covers the in-loop keep-out term against a permuted state. Used to test that the controller and the solver drive a model through its declared mapping rather than through the bundled state ordering. Test fixture only.
